title: Note
description: A short text post — the fediverse-canonical Note.

content.description: The note text. May contain HTML in fediverse usage.

summary.description: Optional short summary or content warning.

published.description: ISO-8601 datetime the note was published.

updated.description: ISO-8601 datetime of the most recent edit.

attributedTo.description: The author — Person or Actor reference.

inReplyTo.description: Optional reference to the Note this is a reply to.

to.description: Audience the note is addressed to (often urn:solid:Public for public posts).
